tools.name: c64_program
tools.title: Runs PRG/CRT files, uploads BASIC or ASM, and coordinates batch test flows.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for program upload, execution, and batch workflows.

path.description: Path to the PRG file: Ultimate path such as //USB0/demo.prg on c64u/u2 (or a host path with location host); host path on VICE.

location.description: auto (default): Ultimate device path on c64u/u2, host path on VICE. host: read the file from the host and upload it (Ultimate). device: Ultimate path only. Limits depend on op.

symbolsFile.description: Label file (VICE .vs, 64tass, ACME or KickAssembler); labels annotate disassembly and are accepted where c64_memory and c64_debug take an address.

program.description: Commodore BASIC v2 program source to upload and run.

verify.description: Poll the screen until the program ends, shows a BASIC error (reported with its line) or the poll window (C64BRIDGE_POLL_MAX_MS, default 2 s) ends. Without verify nothing is observed. Limits depend on op.

autoFix.description: With verify:true, on a BASIC error append a missing closing quote or parenthesis to the failing line and run again (default true; rewritten lines are reported). Set false for programs with side effects.

programs.description: Programs to run in order (at most 64).

type.description: Assertion type; sid_silent needs the C64 Ultimate audio stream (c64u backend).

continueOnError.description: Continue running programs after assertion failure

durationMs.description: Duration to run each program before assertions

outputPath.description: Output directory for test results Limits depend on op.

resetDelayMs.description: Delay after reset operations to allow the platform to settle.

memoryRanges.description: Memory snapshots, at most 256 ranges and 2 MiB of requested memory in total.

captureDebugReg.description: Capture Ultimate debug registers (C64U/U64 only). Defaults to true on C64U/U64 and false on U2/VICE.

messageTemplate.description: Greeting template. Use {PLATFORM}/{BACKEND} for uppercase or {platform}/{backend} for lowercase substitution.

captureScreenshot.description: Capture a framebuffer screenshot on C64U/U64 or VICE. U2 skips it by default; requesting it on U2 fails before execution.

restoreActiveBackend.description: Restore the backend that was active before the workflow started.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for each greeting to appear on screen.

pollIntervalMs.description: Delay between screen polls while verifying the greeting.

inputSchema.description:
Program operations available via the c64_program tool.

Operations:
- load_prg [write]: Load a PRG into memory without running it (Ultimate path, host path on VICE, or location host). Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: location, symbolsFile.
- run_prg [write]: Load and run a PRG: Ultimate path on c64u/u2 (location host uploads a host file), host path on VICE. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: location, symbolsFile.
- run_crt [c64u, u2] [write]: Run a CRT cartridge image from an Ultimate path, or upload a host file with location host (c64u/u2). Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: location.
- upload_run_basic [write]: Tokenize BASIC v2 source, upload and run it; verify:true reports BASIC errors with their line. Required inputs: program. Optional inputs: verify, autoFix.
- upload_run_asm [write]: Assemble 6502/6510 source (ACME, ca65 and 64tass directive spellings; .include/.incbin read host files), upload and run it. Required inputs: program. Optional inputs: verify.
- batch_run [write]: Run multiple PRG/CRT programs with post-run assertions. Required inputs: programs. Optional inputs: continueOnError, durationMs, outputPath, resetDelayMs.
- bundle_run [write]: Capture screen, memory and debug registers into a bundle. Required inputs: runId, outputPath. Optional inputs: captureScreen, memoryRanges, captureDebugReg.
- cross_platform_greeting [write]: Show a platform-specific greeting on configured backends, capture screenshots and verify. Optional inputs: platforms, messageTemplate, verify, captureScreenshot, outputPath, restoreActiveBackend, timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs.

tools.name: c64_memory
tools.title: Reads or writes RAM, captures the screen, or waits for text matches in one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for memory I/O, screen reads, and screen polling.

address.description: Start address: $HHHH, 0xHHHH, decimal, a loaded program label or documented name (screen, CHROUT), optionally +n or -n.

length.description: Bytes to read (default 256, cut at $FFFF when not given). Limits depend on op.

format.description: hex (default): one hex string; dump: 16 bytes per line with addresses and PETSCII.

bytes.description: Hex bytes to write, like $AABBCC or AA BB CC.

verify.description: Verify by reading before and after (Ultimate pauses meanwhile).

expected.description: Optional hex data expected before the write (verifies before writing).

mask.description: Optional verification mask (hex); only bits set in the mask are compared.

abortOnMismatch.description: Abort the write when the pre-write verification fails.

pattern.description: Substring or regex to find (^ and $ match at row boundaries; max 200 characters; backreferences and nested quantifiers may be rejected) Limits depend on op.

intervalMs.description: Poll interval in milliseconds (minimum 20; values above 5000 are clamped to 5000)

instructionCount.description: Stop after this many instructions; replaces length (reads 3 x instructionCount bytes, fewer near $FFFF).

source.description: Source start address, in the same forms as address.

dest.description: Destination start address, in the same forms as source.

includeIo.description: Ultimate: also read $D000-$DFFF; reading I/O can clear CIA interrupts. No effect on VICE.

startAddress.description: Start of the search range, in the same forms as address.

endAddress.description: End of the search range (inclusive), in the same forms as startAddress.

address1.description: First region start address, in the same forms as address.

address2.description: Second region start address, in the same forms as address1.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path for the output file.

asPrg.description: Prepend a 2-byte little-endian load-address header (PRG format). Default: true.

inputSchema.description:
Memory operations available via the c64_memory tool.

Operations:
- read: Read a range of bytes and return a hex dump with address metadata. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: length, format, bank.
- write [write]: Write a hexadecimal byte sequence into RAM. Required inputs: address, bytes. Optional inputs: verify, expected, mask, abortOnMismatch.
- read_screen: Return the current 40x25 text screen converted to ASCII.
- wait_for_text: Poll the screen until a substring or regex appears, or timeout elapses. Required inputs: pattern. Optional inputs: isRegex, caseInsensitive, timeoutMs, intervalMs.
- list_basic: List the BASIC program in memory as text: reads the $2B-$2E pointers, walks the line links and detokenises.
- disassemble: Disassemble a memory region into annotated 6502/6510 instructions, including undocumented opcodes. Labels from loaded `.vs` files annotate the listing. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: length, instructionCount.
- copy_memory [write]: Copy a RAM region to another address. Required inputs: source, dest, length. Optional inputs: includeIo.
- fill_memory [write]: Fill a memory range with a repeating byte pattern. Required inputs: address, length, pattern.
- search_memory: Search for a byte pattern within a memory range and return matching addresses. Required inputs: startAddress, endAddress, pattern. Optional inputs: maxResults, includeIo.
- compare_memory: Compare two memory regions byte-by-byte and report differences. Required inputs: address1, address2, length. Optional inputs: maxDiffs, includeIo.
- save_memory [write]: Dump a memory range to a local file, with an optional PRG load-address header. Required inputs: startAddress, endAddress, filePath. Optional inputs: asPrg, includeIo.

tools.name: c64_sound
tools.title: Adjusts SID registers, plays files, composes music, and runs verification captures.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for SID control, playback, composition, and analysis workflows.

count.description: Stereo sample pairs to capture; at most 65536 (about 1.37 s).

encoding.description: Encoding used for the PCM sample payload.

volume.description: SID master volume 0-15. Writes all of $D418, clearing filter mode bits.

filterMode.description: Optional $D418 bits 4-7 (0-15: low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, voice 3 off). Default 0 clears them.

hard.description: If true, perform a hard register scrub; otherwise silence voices softly.

voice.description: SID voice to trigger (1-3). Limits depend on op.

note.description: Musical note like A4, C#5, or Bb3. Overrides frequencyHz if provided.

frequencyHz.description: Explicit frequency in Hz. Used when note is omitted.

system.description: PAL or NTSC for the note frequency. Default: read from the machine ($02A6).

waveform.description: SID waveform to enable. Limits depend on op.

pulseWidth.description: Pulse width (0-4095). Used for pulse waveform.

verify.description: When true, record audio after silencing to confirm the SID output is quiet.

path.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the SID, PRG, or audio file.

songnr.description: Song number within the SID file (0-based index).

pattern.description: Repeating lead semitone offsets from root.

preset.description: Classic or varied lead phrasing. Limits depend on op.

sidwave.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object. Limits depend on op.

cpg.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object. Limits depend on op.

format.description: Source format hint when providing raw text.

output.description: Target format. PRG works everywhere; SID playback needs C64U/U64 or U2 (SID export with dryRun works everywhere).

dryRun.description: Skip playback and return only compilation metadata (use outputPath to export).

outputPath.description: Host file for the compiled PRG or SID, inside the allowed directories. Works with dryRun.

analysisDurationSeconds.description: Length of the verification recording on analyzable backends. Limits depend on op.

waitBeforeCaptureMs.description: Delay between starting playback and beginning verification capture. Limits depend on op.

restoreActiveBackend.description: Restore the backend that was active before the workflow started.

expectedSidwave.description: Optional expected SIDWAVE used to refine analysis comparisons. Limits depend on op.

verifySilenceBefore.description: Record a quiet baseline before playback (adds the silence duration). Default false.

verifySilenceAfter.description: Record after playback to confirm the voices were released (adds the silence duration). Default false.

silenceDurationSeconds.description: Audio capture length used for silence verification.

silenceRmsThreshold.description: RMS threshold applied to silence verification captures.

postSilenceWaitMs.description: Delay between main analysis capture and the post-playback silence check (milliseconds).

silenceWaitMs.description: Delay between silencing the SID and recording during pre/post checks (milliseconds).

request.description: Verification goal wording; "does it sound right" requests add a verdict.

durationSeconds.description: Override capture duration in seconds. Limits depend on op.

inputSchema.description:
Sound operations available via the c64_sound tool.

Operations:
- capture_samples [c64u]: Capture raw stereo PCM samples from the Ultimate audio UDP stream. Optional inputs: count, encoding.
- set_volume [write]: Set the SID master volume register at $D418 (0-15). Required inputs: volume. Optional inputs: filterMode.
- reset [write]: Soft or hard reset of the SID registers. Optional inputs: hard.
- note_on [write]: Trigger a SID voice with configurable waveform, ADSR, and pitch. Optional inputs: voice, note, frequencyHz, system, waveform, pulseWidth, attack, decay, sustain, release.
- note_off [write]: Release a SID voice by clearing its gate bit. Required inputs: voice.
- silence_all [write]: Silence all SID voices with optional audio verification. Optional inputs: verify.
- play_sid_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play a SID file stored on the Ultimate filesystem. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: songnr.
- play_mod_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play a MOD tracker module via the Ultimate SID player. Required inputs: path.
- generate [write]: Compose and play eight SIDWAVE bars by default as a PRG, which replaces the program in memory. Root sets key/register, pattern gives lead offsets, steps sets lead count, tempoMs sets classic spacing, waveform sets lead sound, preset sets phrasing, and system sets PAL/NTSC timing. Optional inputs: root, pattern, steps, tempoMs, waveform, preset, system, style, seed.
- compile_play [write]: Compile SIDWAVE or CPG source and optionally play it immediately. Optional inputs: sidwave, cpg, format, output, dryRun, outputPath.
- play_preset [write]: Compile and play a built-in SID preset. Optional inputs: preset, platforms, verify, analysisDurationSeconds, waitBeforeCaptureMs, restoreActiveBackend.
- pipeline [write]: Compile a SIDWAVE score, play and analyze it. Optional inputs: sidwave, cpg, output, waitBeforeCaptureMs, analysisDurationSeconds, expectedSidwave, verifySilenceBefore, verifySilenceAfter, silenceDurationSeconds, silenceRmsThreshold, postSilenceWaitMs, silenceWaitMs.
- analyze: Analyze SID playback when verification is requested. Optional inputs: request, durationSeconds, expectedSidwave.
- record_analyze: Record audio for a fixed duration and return SID analysis metrics (Ultimate stream on c64u, host microphone on other backends). Required inputs: durationSeconds. Optional inputs: expectedSidwave.

tools.name: c64_system
tools.title: Manages machine state (pause, reset, power) and schedules recurring background tasks.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for power, reset, menu, and background task control.

waitForReady.description: Wait for the BASIC READY. prompt before returning; a timeout gives ready=false, not an error.

readyTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for READY. when waitForReady is true (1-120000 ms).

name.description: Unique task name (letters, digits, spaces, '_', '-', '.'; must not start with '.' or a space). Limits depend on op.

operation.description: Operation name: read, write, read_screen or menu_button (read_memory and write_memory are aliases). write requires arguments.address and arguments.bytes.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of iterations (1 to 100000; omit for indefinite)

includeTimeline.description: Include the tail of the event timeline.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of span and timeline entries to return.

inputSchema.description:
System operations available via the c64_system tool.

Operations:
- pause [write]: Pause the machine until resumed.
- resume [write]: Resume CPU execution after a pause.
- reset [write]: Issue a soft reset without cutting power. Optional inputs: waitForReady, readyTimeoutMs.
- reboot [destructive]: Trigger a firmware reboot to recover from faults. Optional inputs: waitForReady, readyTimeoutMs.
- poweroff [c64u, vice] [destructive]: Shut down C64U/U64 or quit VICE. U2-family hardware cannot power off. On C64U/U64 software cannot restart it: power must be restored at the outlet, and it starts by itself only if automatic startup on power restoration is enabled.
- power_cycle [destructive]: Return the backend to a fresh state. C64U/U64 Tool Menu verification needs machine:menu_screen (U64 3.15+ or supporting C64U firmware); U2-family reboots through REST. Optional inputs: waitForReady, readyTimeoutMs.
- menu [c64u, u2] [write]: Toggle the Ultimate menu button.
- read_menu_screen [c64u, u2]: Read the active Ultimate menu's raw character and colour matrix through machine:menu_screen (needs firmware support; U64/U2 3.15+).
- start_task [write]: Start a named interval task. Required inputs: name, operation. Optional inputs: arguments, intervalMs, maxIterations.
- stop_task: Stop a background task. Required inputs: name.
- stop_all_tasks: Stop all running tasks and persist state.
- delete_task [write]: Delete a finished task and its artifacts; stop running tasks first. Required inputs: name.
- list_tasks: List background tasks with status.
- performance_report: Summarize diagnostics spans and tool latencies of the current or latest session. Optional inputs: scope, includeTimeline, maxEntries.

tools.name: c64_select_backend
tools.title: Changes the active backend without restarting the MCP server and reports resulting tool availability.
tools.description: Switch the active backend between C64U/U64 hardware, U2-family cartridges, and the VICE emulator at runtime.

backend.description: Backend to activate for subsequent tool calls.

inputSchema.description:
Runtime backend selection operations.

Operations:
- select: Switch the active runtime backend without restarting the MCP server. Required inputs: backend.

tools.name: c64_graphics
tools.title: Captures frames, renders PETSCII text or art, previews sprites, and displays bitmap images from one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for frame capture and graphics rendering workflows.

includePixels.description: Include raw pixel bytes (about 100 KB per frame; responses above 2 MiB are rejected, so lower count).

format.description: png returns each frame as an MCP image block (max 4 frames per call). Limits depend on op.

encoding.description: Encoding used for the pixel payload when included.

prompt.description: Natural language prompt describing the desired PETSCII art.

text.description: Exact text to render in PETSCII (overrides prompt derivation). Limits depend on op.

borderColor.description: Border colour index (0-15). Limits depend on op.

backgroundColor.description: Background colour index (0-15). Limits depend on op.

dryRun.description: When true, skip uploading the generated BASIC program to the C64.

bitmap.description: Explicit bitmap definition for PETSCII rendering.

sprite.description: 63-byte sprite definition provided as base64/hex string or array of bytes.

index.description: Sprite index (0-7) to configure in screen memory.

multicolour.description: Enable multicolour mode for the sprite.

dataAddress.description: Where to write the 64-byte block (multiple of 64, inside the current VIC bank); default is chosen clear of screen, charset and bitmap.

imagePath.description: Filesystem path of the source image (PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and other Jimp-supported formats).

bitmapAddress.description: Absolute C64 memory address, provided as an integer or hex string such as $2000.

screenAddress.description: Absolute C64 memory address, provided as an integer or hex string such as $2000.

preserveAspect.description: Preserve the source image aspect ratio and pad with the background colour.

inputSchema.description:
Graphics operations available via the c64_graphics tool.

Operations:
- capture_frame [c64u, vice]: Capture one or more complete video frames from the active backend. Optional inputs: count, includePixels, format, encoding.
- render_petscii_art [write]: Create PETSCII art from a prompt, text or bitmap data, optionally displaying it. Optional inputs: prompt, text, maxWidth, maxHeight, borderColor, backgroundColor, foregroundColor, dryRun, bitmap.
- render_petscii_text [write]: Display PETSCII text with optional border and background colours. Required inputs: text. Optional inputs: borderColor, backgroundColor.
- render_sprite [write]: Display 63-byte sprite data at a position and colour by writing memory and VIC-II registers. Required inputs: sprite. Optional inputs: index, x, y, color, multicolour, dataAddress.
- render_bitmap [write]: Convert an image file to VIC-II bitmap memory, write it to RAM and display it. Required inputs: imagePath, format. Optional inputs: bitmapAddress, screenAddress, borderColor, backgroundColor, preserveAspect.
- get_display_state: Read VIC-II and CIA2 registers to determine the current graphics mode and memory layout.

tools.name: c64_rag
tools.title: Returns knowledge references for BASIC (basic), 6502/6510 assembly (asm) or all curated docs including game development and Ultimate features (docs).
tools.description: Grouped entry point for BASIC, assembly and curated-docs RAG lookups.

q.description: Natural-language query describing the desired BASIC or assembly guidance.

k.description: Maximum number of references to return (1-12).

inputSchema.description:
RAG operations available via the c64_rag tool.

Operations:
- basic: Retrieve BASIC references and snippets from the local knowledge base. Required inputs: q. Optional inputs: k.
- asm: Retrieve 6502/6510 assembly references from the local knowledge base. Required inputs: q. Optional inputs: k.
- docs: Search all curated docs (hardware, Ultimate features, game development, specs) with no BASIC/assembly filter. Required inputs: q. Optional inputs: k.

tools.name: c64_disk
tools.title: Mount or unmount images, create new disks, list drives, and find programs from one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for disk mounts, listings, image creation, and program discovery.

drive.description: Drive identifier (for example drive8). Limits depend on op.

image.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the disk image.

type.description: Override detected image type when firmware guesses incorrectly.

attachmentMode.description: Attachment mode controlling how the firmware treats the mounted image.

location.description: device (default): Ultimate path. host: upload the image from the host (needs verify false; type from the extension).

driveMode.description: Drive emulation mode to switch to during verification.

verify.description: When true, power on/reset/verify using the reliability workflow.

powerOnIfNeeded.description: Power on the drive automatically before mounting when verify=true.

resetAfterMount.description: Issue a drive reset after mounting when verify=true.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of mount retries when verify=true.

retryDelayMs.description: Delay between mount retry attempts when verify=true.

path.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the disk image to mount or manage.

diskname.description: Optional disk label (1-16 characters, converted to PETSCII).

tracks.description: Track count (D64 supports 35 to 41; DNP requires explicit tracks).

root.description: Root path to search Limits depend on op.

waitMs.description: Delay after firmware run before returning

captureCandidates.description: Include up to this many candidates in result

inputSchema.description:
Disk operations available via the c64_disk tool.

Operations:
- list_drives: List drive slots and mounted images.
- mount [write]: Mount a disk image with optional verification/retries. Required inputs: drive, image. Optional inputs: type, attachmentMode, location, driveMode, verify, powerOnIfNeeded, resetAfterMount, maxRetries, retryDelayMs.
- unmount [c64u, u2] [write]: Unmount the image from a drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- file_info [c64u, u2]: Inspect a file on the Ultimate filesystem. Required inputs: path.
- create_image [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Create a blank disk image of the specified format. An existing file at the path is not overwritten; the call fails and a different path (or deleting the file first) is needed. Required inputs: format, path. Optional inputs: diskname, tracks.
- find_and_run [c64u, u2] [write]: Search for a PRG/CRT by name substring and run the first match. Required inputs: nameContains. Optional inputs: root, extensions, caseInsensitive, sort, waitMs, captureCandidates.
- find_paths [c64u, u2]: Search Ultimate storage for paths containing a name substring, without running anything. Required inputs: nameContains. Optional inputs: root, extensions, maxResults, caseInsensitive.

tools.name: c64_drive
tools.title: Power cycle drive slots, reset IEC state, switch emulation modes, or load custom ROMs.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for drive power, mode, reset, and ROM operations.

drive.description: Drive identifier: a, b, softiec (or "IEC Drive"), or a bus number such as 8 or drive8.

path.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the disk image to mount or manage.

inputSchema.description:
Drive operations available via the c64_drive tool.

Operations:
- reset [write]: Issue an IEC reset for the selected drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- power_on [write]: Power on a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- power_off [write]: Power off a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- load_rom [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Temporarily load a custom ROM into an Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive, path.
- set_mode [write]: Set the emulation mode for a drive slot (1541/1571/1581). Required inputs: drive, mode.

tools.name: c64_printer
tools.title: Print text or bitmaps and define custom characters for Commodore or Epson printers.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for Commodore and Epson printing helpers.

text.description: Text to print on the connected printer.

target.description: Printer target: Commodore MPS (PETSCII) or Epson FX (ESC/P).

secondaryAddress.description: Secondary address for device 4 (0 = upper/graphics, 7 = lowercase). Limits depend on op.

formFeed.description: Emit a form-feed (CHR$(12)) at the end of the job.

repeats.description: Number of times to repeat the row (1-255).

useSubRepeat.description: Repeat the next byte this many times (Commodore BIM SUB).

ensureMsb.description: Ensure MSB set for Commodore printers.

density.description: Density parameter when using Epson mode '*'.

timesPerLine.description: Number of times to print the row per line (1-10).

firstChar.description: PETSCII code of first character to redefine (33-126).

items.description: Commodore MPS DLL character definition (11 columns).

inputSchema.description:
Printer operations available via the c64_printer tool.

Operations:
- print_text [write]: Generate BASIC that prints text to device 4. Required inputs: text. Optional inputs: target, secondaryAddress, formFeed.
- print_bitmap [write]: Print a bitmap row via Commodore (BIM) or Epson ESC/P workflows. Required inputs: printer, columns. Optional inputs: repeats, useSubRepeat, secondaryAddress, ensureMsb, mode, density, timesPerLine.
- define_chars [write]: Define custom printer characters (Commodore DLL mode). Required inputs: firstChar, chars. Optional inputs: secondaryAddress.

tools.name: c64_config
tools.title: List or update settings, access firmware info, take snapshots, and run program shuffle workflows.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for configuration reads/writes, diagnostics, and snapshots.

category.description: Configuration category reported by the Ultimate firmware (e.g. 'Audio'). Limits depend on op.

item.description: Specific configuration item inside the selected category (e.g. 'Volume'). Limits depend on op.

includeSecretValues.description: Return credential values (network password, FTP/Telnet passwords, Wi-Fi keys) in plain text. Default false: those values are replaced with ***.

value.description: Primitive configuration value (string, number, or boolean). Limits depend on op.

updates.description: Categories mapped to item/value pairs (primitive values only), for example {"Audio": {"Volume": 80}}.

additionalProperties.description: Item/value pairs of one category (primitive values only).

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path where the snapshot file will be written.

applyToFlash.description: When true, save the restored configuration to flash immediately (C64U/U64 and U2 only).

root.description: Directory to search for programs (not recursive; the firmware lookup returns one match per extension)

durationMs.description: Duration to run each program in milliseconds

maxPrograms.description: Maximum number of programs to run

outputPath.description: Output directory for run logs and captures

resetDelayMs.description: Delay after reset operations to allow the platform to settle.

inputSchema.description:
Configuration operations available via the c64_config tool.

Operations:
- list: List configuration categories reported by the firmware.
- get: Read a configuration category or specific item. Required inputs: category. Optional inputs: item, includeSecretValues.
- set [write]: Write a configuration value in the selected category. Required inputs: category, item, value.
- batch_update [write]: Apply several configuration updates at once. Pass `updates` as {category: {item: value}}. Optional inputs: updates.
- load_flash [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Load configuration from flash. Optional inputs: category.
- save_flash [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Persist the configuration to flash. Optional inputs: category.
- reset_defaults [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Reset configuration to factory defaults. Optional inputs: category.
- read_debugreg [c64u]: Read the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF).
- write_debugreg [c64u] [destructive]: Write a hex value to the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF). Required inputs: value.
- info: Retrieve Ultimate hardware information and status.
- version: Fetch firmware version details.
- snapshot [write]: Snapshot configuration to disk. Required inputs: path.
- restore [write]: Restore configuration from a snapshot file. Writes only items that differ from the device; if the device refuses a category (e.g. 403 for a wrong network password), the others are still restored and the error names the failed categories. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: applyToFlash.
- diff: Compare configuration with a snapshot. Required inputs: path.
- shuffle [c64u, u2] [write]: Discover PRG/CRT files and run each, optionally capturing the screen. Optional inputs: root, extensions, durationMs, captureScreen, maxPrograms, outputPath, resetDelayMs.

tools.name: c64_extract
tools.title: Export sprites or charsets, dump RAM, compute filesystem stats, or run firmware health checks.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for sprite/charset extraction, memory dumps, filesystem stats, and firmware health checks.

address.description: Start address ($HHHH or decimal) Limits depend on op.

length.description: Number of bytes to scan Limits depend on op.

minSetBits.description: Minimum number of set bits required

includeBase64.description: Include each sprite as base64 too

pauseDuringRead.description: Pause the machine during memory read

scanRange.description: Range to scan if address not provided: 'common' or 'full'

outputPath.description: File path to write charset binary Limits depend on op.

includeContainers.description: Include container images (d64/d81/etc.) in extension stats

maxSamplesPerExtension.description: Number of sample paths to keep per extension

inputSchema.description:
Extraction operations available via the c64_extract tool.

Operations:
- sprites [write]: Scan RAM for sprites and optionally export .spr files. Required inputs: address, length. Optional inputs: stride, maxSprites, minNonZeroRows, minSetBits, includeBase64, includeRows, outputDir, pauseDuringRead.
- charset [write]: Locate and extract 2KB character sets from RAM. Optional inputs: address, scanRange, outputPath, pauseDuringRead, minNonEmptyChars, minEntropy.
- memory_dump [write]: Dump a RAM range to hex or binary files with manifest metadata. Required inputs: address, length, outputPath. Optional inputs: format, chunkSize, pauseDuringRead, retries.
- fs_stats [c64u, u2]: Per-extension size statistics for one directory (no recursion); the firmware returns at most one file per extension. Optional inputs: root, extensions, includeContainers, maxSamplesPerExtension.
- firmware_health: Run firmware readiness checks and report status metrics.

tools.name: c64_stream
tools.title: Start or stop audio/video/debug streaming in a single tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for starting and stopping Ultimate streaming sessions.

target.description: UDP stream destination: IPv4 address or hostname, optional :port (1-65535), e.g. 192.168.1.10:11000. Sent unencrypted.

inputSchema.description:
Streaming operations available via the c64_stream tool.

Operations:
- start [write]: Start an Ultimate streaming session. The device sends an unencrypted UDP stream to the target (IPv4 address or hostname, optional :port). Required inputs: stream, target.
- stop [write]: Stop an active Ultimate streaming session. Required inputs: stream.

tools.name: c64_debug
tools.title: Manage breakpoints, inspect registers, and step through code on the VICE backend.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for VICE debugger operations (breakpoints, registers, stepping).

address.description: Start address: $HHHH, 0xHHHH, decimal, a loaded program label or documented name (screen, CHROUT), optionally +n or -n.

endAddress.description: End address (inclusive) of an address range, in the same forms as address.

enabled.description: Whether the checkpoint is enabled (default true). Limits depend on op.

items.description: Selects a register by id or name.

value.description: Value: integer, or string such as "$C000" or a label[+n].

expectedPC.description: PC address to wait for, in the same forms as address.

inputSchema.description:
Available debugger operations.

Operations:
- list_checkpoints: List all active VICE checkpoints (breakpoints).
- get_checkpoint: Fetch a single checkpoint by id. Required inputs: id.
- create_checkpoint [write]: Create a new checkpoint (breakpoint) in VICE. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: endAddress, stopOnHit, enabled, temporary, label, operations, memspace.
- delete_checkpoint [write]: Remove a checkpoint by id. Required inputs: id.
- toggle_checkpoint [write]: Enable or disable a checkpoint by id. Required inputs: id, enabled.
- set_condition [write]: Attach a conditional expression to a checkpoint. Required inputs: id, expression.
- list_registers: List available registers (metadata). Optional inputs: memspace.
- get_registers: Read register values, optionally filtered by name or id. Optional inputs: memspace, registers.
- set_registers [write]: Write register values. Required inputs: writes. Optional inputs: memspace.
- step [write]: Single-step CPU execution. Optional inputs: count, mode.
- step_return [write]: Continue execution until the current routine returns.
- get_monitor_state: Read CPU registers and return the current monitor state. Optional inputs: memspace.
- wait_for_state: Wait until the CPU is stopped (checkpoint hit or step) and, with expectedPC, PC equals it, or the timeout elapses. Without a debug session the registers are polled. Optional inputs: expectedPC, timeoutMs, pollMs.
- nuclear_reset [destructive]: Kill and restart the VICE process (managed instances only).
- continue_execution [write]: Exit the Binary Monitor and resume CPU execution (BM 0xAA Exit).

tools.name: c64_vice
tools.title: Reads or updates selected VICE resources that are safe to expose through MCP.

inputSchema.description:
VICE emulator operations available via the c64_vice tool.

Operations:
- resource_get: Read a VICE configuration resource (safe prefixes only). Required inputs: name.
- resource_set [write]: Write a VICE configuration resource (safe prefixes only). Required inputs: name, value.
- snapshot_save [write]: Save snapshot. Required inputs: path.
- snapshot_restore [destructive]: Restore snapshot. Required inputs: path.
- version: VICE version.

tools.name: c64_input
tools.title: Types text, sends physical key combinations, and controls joysticks.
tools.description: Cross-platform PETSCII typing plus native Ultimate keyboard and joystick events.

text.description: Text to type: printable ASCII (letters are sent as PETSCII upper case), \n for RETURN, and {TOKEN}s such as {RETURN}, {CLR}, {F1}…{F8}, {UP}, {DOWN}, {LEFT}, {RIGHT}, colour names, or {$1D}/{29} codes. Characters with no PETSCII mapping and unknown tokens are rejected.

key.description: Key to press: a printable character or PETSCII token name (RETURN, F1…F8, UP). STOP only types code 3 and may not break a running program; use op keyboard with run_stop on C64U.

durationMs.description: Delay in ms between presses (default 0). Limits depend on op.

count.description: Number of times to press the key (default 1).

controls.description: List of controls to activate simultaneously.

action.description: press = hold until a release call; release = restore all bits; tap = press then release after durationMs.

inputs.description: One or more keys to transition together (for example left_shift + a).

transition.description: press holds, release frees, tap presses and releases.

inputSchema.description:
Input operations: write_text, key, keyboard, joystick, release_all, state.

Operations:
- write_text [write]: Send a text string to the keyboard buffer, with PETSCII token expansion. Required inputs: text. Optional inputs: delayMs.
- key [write]: Press one key one or more times, optionally with a delay. Required inputs: key. Optional inputs: durationMs, count.
- joystick [c64u, vice] [write]: Simulate joystick input. On C64U/U64 this uses machine:input. On VICE it attaches the joyport simulation device, which also pulls CIA lines 5-7 low: port 1 produces phantom keys and port 2 reads $1E for up instead of $7E. Prefer port 2 on VICE and test bits 0-4. Required inputs: port, controls, action. Optional inputs: durationMs.
- keyboard [c64u] [write]: Send physical C64 keyboard matrix events through machine:input (needs firmware support; U64 3.15+). Required inputs: inputs, transition.
- release_all [c64u] [write]: Release every key and joystick control injected through machine:input.
- state [c64u]: Read the keys and joystick controls held through machine:input.

tools.name: c64_batch
tools.title: Runs an ordered list of tool commands and returns all results with per-command timing.
tools.description: Execute multiple c64bridge tool calls in a single request. Reduces latency for multi-step workflows.

commands.description: Ordered list of commands to execute.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the tool (must include 'op' for grouped tools).

description.description: Optional label for this command in the result.

stopOnError.description: Halt the batch after the first failure. Default: true.

inputSchema.description: Execute multiple tool calls in one request.
